raw_content: {"internal_thinking":"Charlie and Alice are finally trading after blocking me. Alice is sitting at 3 VP and just got wheat from Charlie, likely setting up her next settlement. I need to keep a low profile and look for an opening to N3 while they focus on each other.","note_to_self":"Alice and Charlie traded (1W for 1Wh). Alice has 3 VP and is the primary threat. I see how it is."}
